verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents serverless 'Fast' model variants built for latency-sensitive workloads, and dedicated on-demand deployments with lower latency and higher throughput. It also documents speculative decoding to cut generation latency, quantization for speed, session-affinity routing to raise prompt-cache hits, no cold starts on serverless, regional deployment close to users, and a benchmarking tool for latency and throughput. missing for 10: explicit time-to-first-token metrics or guarantees, independent or hands-on benchmark corroboration of the speed claims.
